import gzip, itertools
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def read(fn):
    return pd.read_csv(fn, sep='\\t', compression='gzip', index_col=0)

rna=read('multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.rna.tsv.gz')
atac=read('multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.atac.tsv.gz')
print(rna.shape, atac.shape)

def corr_cols(X):
    # X features x samples
    return np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)

def prep(X, mode):
    A=X.astype(float).values
    if mode.startswith('log'):
        A=np.log1p(A)
    if 'filter' in mode:
        # keep features with variation across columns and nonzero somewhere
        v=A.var(axis=1)
        mu=A.mean(axis=1)
        mask=(v>0)&(mu>0)
        A=A[mask]
    if 'topvar' in mode:
        v=A.var(axis=1)
        n=min(50000, len(v))
        idx=np.argpartition(v, -n)[-n:]
        A=A[idx]
    if 'zfeat' in mode:
        m=A.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True); s=A.std(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        mask=s[:,0]>0
        A=(A[mask]-m[mask])/s[mask]
    return A

def score(Cr,Ca,p):
    Cp=Ca[np.ix_(p,p)]
    # off diagonal correlation/sse
    triu=np.triu_indices(8,1)
    a=Cr[triu]; b=Cp[triu]
    return np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1], -np.mean((a-b)**2)

modes=['raw_filter','log_filter','log_filter_zfeat','log_filter_topvar','log_filter_topvar_zfeat','raw_filter_topvar_zfeat']
for mr in modes:
  R=prep(rna,mr)
  Cr=corr_cols(R)
  print('\\nRNA mode',mr,'shape',R.shape,'Cr offdiag range',Cr[np.triu_indices(8,1)].min(),Cr[np.triu_indices(8,1)].max())
  for ma in modes:
    A=prep(atac,ma)
    Ca=corr_cols(A)
    best=[]
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(8)):
        sc=score(Cr,Ca,p)
        best.append((sc,p))
    best.sort(reverse=True, key=lambda x:(x[0][0],x[0][1]))
    print(' ATAC',ma,'shape',A.shape,'best corr %.4f sse %.6f p %s second %.4f %s'% (best[0][0][0], -best[0][0][1], ';'.join(map(str,best[0][1])), best[1][0][0], ';'.join(map(str,best[1][1]))))

import gzip, re, itertools, os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import rankdata

rna_fn='multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.rna.tsv.gz'
atac_fn='multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.atac.tsv.gz'
gtf='gencode.v44.annotation.gtf.gz'

rna=pd.read_csv(rna_fn, sep='\\t', compression='gzip', index_col=0)
atac=pd.read_csv(atac_fn, sep='\\t', compression='gzip', index_col=0)
print('loaded', rna.shape, atac.shape)

# parse GENCODE gene records by gene_name
attr_re=re.compile(r'(\\S+) \"(["'^"]+)"'"')
genes=[]
with gzip.open(gtf,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if not line or line[0]=='#': continue
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(parts)<9 or parts[2] "'!= '"'gene': continue
        chrom, start, end, strand, attrs = parts[0], int(parts[3]), int(parts[4]), parts[6], parts[8]
        d=dict(attr_re.findall(attrs))
        name=d.get('gene_name')
        if not name: continue
        tss = start-1 if strand=='+' else end-1  # 0-based coordinate
        genes.append((name, chrom, tss))
print('gtf genes', len(genes))

rna_genes=set(rna.index)
atac_index=set(atac.index)

def make_pairs(window=0, agg='sum'):
    rows=[]; peaks=[]; seen=set()
    for name, chrom, tss in genes:
        if name not in rna_genes: continue
        base=(tss//10000)*10000
        peak_names=[]
        for off in range(-window, window+1):
            s=base+off*10000
            if s<0: continue
            p=f'{chrom}_{s}_{s+10000}'
            if p in atac_index:
                peak_names.append(p)
        if not peak_names: continue
        key=(name, tuple(peak_names))
        if key in seen: continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append(name); peaks.append(peak_names)
    R=np.log1p(rna.loc[rows].to_numpy(float))
    if window==0:
        A=np.log1p(atac.loc[[ps[0] for ps in peaks]].to_numpy(float))
    else:
        # aggregate raw counts over window, then log1p
        mats=np.stack([atac.loc[ps].to_numpy(float).sum(axis=0) for ps in peaks])
        A=np.log1p(mats)
    # filter informative pairs
    mask=(R.var(axis=1)>0)&(A.var(axis=1)>0)&(R.mean(axis=1)>0)&(A.mean(axis=1)>0)
    return R[mask], A[mask], np.array(rows)[mask]

def pearson_cols(R,A):
    Rz=(R-R.mean(axis=0))/R.std(axis=0)
    Az=(A-A.mean(axis=0))/A.std(axis=0)
    return (Rz.T@Az)/(R.shape[0]-1)

def spearman_cols(R,A):
    Rr=np.apply_along_axis(rankdata,0,R)
    Ar=np.apply_along_axis(rankdata,0,A)
    return pearson_cols(Rr,Ar)

for window in [0,1,2,5,10]:
    R,A,names=make_pairs(window)
    print('\\nwindow',window,'pairs',len(names))
    for label,func in [('pearson',pearson_cols),('spearman',spearman_cols)]:
        C=func(R,A)
        print(label)
        print(np.array2string(C, precision=4, suppress_small=True))
        print('row argmax', ';'.join(map(str,C.argmax(axis=1))))
        print('col argmax', ';'.join(map(str,C.argmax(axis=0))))
        # assignment max sum
        best=max(itertools.permutations(range(8)), key=lambda p: sum(C[i,p[i]] for i in range(8)))
        print('best assign', ';'.join(map(str,best)), 'sum', sum(C[i,best[i]] for i in range(8)))

import gzip, re, itertools
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import rankdata

genes=[]
with gzip.open('gencode.v44.annotation.gtf.gz','rt') as f:
  for line in f:
    if line.startswith('#'): continue
    parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(parts)<9 or parts[2]"'!='"'gene': continue
    d=dict(attr_re.findall(parts[8])); name=d.get('gene_name')
    if not name or name not in rna_genes: continue
    chrom=parts[0]; start=int(parts[3]); end=int(parts[4]); strand=parts[6]
    tss=start-1 if strand=='+' else end-1
    base=(tss//10000)*10000
    p=f'{chrom}_{base}_{base+10000}'
    if p in atac_index:
      genes.append((name,p))
# unique gene names
seen=set(); pairs=[]
for name,p in genes:
  if name not in seen:
    seen.add(name); pairs.append((name,p))
rows=[x[0] for x in pairs]; peaks=[x[1] for x in pairs]
R=np.log1p(rna.loc[rows].to_numpy(float)); A=np.log1p(atac.loc[peaks].to_numpy(float))
mask=(R.var(axis=1)>0)&(A.var(axis=1)>0)&(R.mean(axis=1)>0)&(A.mean(axis=1)>0)
R=R[mask]; A=A[mask]
print('pairs',R.shape[0])

def row_z(X):
  m=X.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True); s=X.std(axis=1,keepdims=True)
  keep=s[:,0]>0
  return (X[keep]-m[keep])/s[keep], keep

def col_corr(X,Y):
  X=(X-X.mean(axis=0))/X.std(axis=0)
  Y=(Y-Y.mean(axis=0))/Y.std(axis=0)
  return X.T@Y/(X.shape[0]-1)

for mode in ['center','z','rank_then_center','rank_then_z']:
  if mode.startswith('rank'):
    R0=np.apply_along_axis(rankdata,1,R)
    A0=np.apply_along_axis(rankdata,1,A)
  else:
    R0=R.copy(); A0=A.copy()
  if mode.endswith('z') or mode=='z':
    R1,k1=row_z(R0); A1,k2=row_z(A0); keep=k1 & k2
    # row_z already dropped independently; easier recompute on common keep
    R1,_=row_z(R0[keep]); A1,_=row_z(A0[keep])
  else:
    R1=R0-R0.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True); A1=A0-A0.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    keep=(R1.var(axis=1)>0)&(A1.var(axis=1)>0); R1=R1[keep]; A1=A1[keep]
  C=col_corr(R1,A1)
  print('\\n',mode)
  print(np.array2string(C,precision=4,suppress_small=True))
  print('row argmax',';'.join(map(str,C.argmax(axis=1))))
  best=max(itertools.permutations(range(8)), key=lambda p:sum(C[i,p[i]] for i in range(8)))
  print('best',';'.join(map(str,best)),sum(C[i,best[i]] for i in range(8)))
  vals=sorted([(sum(C[i,p[i]] for i in range(8)),p) for p in itertools.permutations(range(8))], reverse=True)
  print('second',';'.join(map(str,vals[1][1])),vals[1][0])
